Actor Tom Skerritt dies at 93

Tom Skerritt, the American actor known for his roles in "Picket Fences", "Alien" and "Top Gun", died at the age of 93; his publicist confirmed the death. He had also appeared in "M*A*S*H" and "Steel Magnolias" and won an Emmy for his work on "Picket Fences".
